const MORE = 0b10000000
const MASK = 0b01111111

func encode(numbers: Array) -> Array:
	"""Encode numbers."""
	var results = []
	for number in numbers:
		var encoded: Array = []
		while number > 0:
			encoded.append(MORE | (number & MASK))
			number >>= 7
		if not encoded:
			encoded.append(0)
		encoded[0] &= MASK
		encoded.reverse()
